question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster and the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

WINTER : EINRTW :: TRAY : ARTY :: LADIES : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/861b11f23f647fcf6f6aa0cfb80cf2c3ec98a9f1871c373dfbb3710429cee1ec.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

WINTER : EINRTW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd7db5f6b64c175f004c85b38cd7d044d2febbfb24dca017c84b84e682f7a8a0.png] 

And

TRAY : ARTY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c17c33113a86e3b1bc2a111235083645fa94219cb1139ffee7942e7d38af32b4.png] 

Similarly,

LADIES : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b15f2ba1db520c9fb2d71c26f976d7f724806550db699430d6b12cbab3a865f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ADEILS".**
